title: Fished Swords
body:
![fished swords](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d5d81ed3a8501be0b98bc71b6c38a0c7eb5cac07.png)
Tired of boring diamond and netherite swords? Want to beat the Ender Dragon using a freshly caught mackerel? Welcome to Fished Swords — the wettest, scaliest, and most absurd resource pack for Minecraft!
